verdict.rationale: Mem0 Platform documents built-in Graph Memory. It automatically builds a native graph linking people, places, and concepts across memories, with no schema and no external graph database. The docs explicitly target entity-centric questions like "what do we know about Alice?" answered from facts pulled across many conversations. missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-hop traversal or querying of relationships (the old relations field was replaced), confirmation that graph memory works in self-hosted Open Source rather than only on Platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of graph retrieval quality.
